palette_rationale: Keep the source-visible black eye meshes, pink anatomy, and orange mouth within the reviewed 63-color Idle palette. No painted pupil, eyelid, or projectile.
reference: Own DSTS chr020 model and native animation clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and timing fields.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native energetic bounded locomotion; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native acrobatic strike with an inverted middle pose; preserve the source arc.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native open-mouth expression/release; no projectile exists in this package.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native crouched/resting motion; source eyes remain open looking.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native recoil; avoids the more extreme bd02/bd03 variants.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native arm/body swing, without adding a weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two repeated native attack cycles; PMDO exposes one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Distinct native high flip and landing arc.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native anticipation/strain with reverse sampled recovery; no effect added.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native head/gaze motion combined with explicit whole-view yaw; endpoint excluded.
